env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/defer_generic_receiver.lgo behavior/main.lgo
cp behavior/main.lgo original.lgo.txt
cd behavior
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/defer_generic_receiver.out
logos eject -o ../behavior-out
cmp main.lgo ../original.lgo.txt
cd ../behavior-out
grep -count=1 'generic-type-comment' main.go
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/defer_generic_receiver.out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/defer_generic_receiver.out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1273/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/defer_generic_receiver.out
cd ../private

logos run .

go run .

exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/private-want.txt
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1273/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/private-want.txt

-- behavior/go.mod --
module example.com/genericreceiver

go 1.27

-- private/go.mod --
module example.com/privatereceiver

go 1.27

require example.com/hidden v1.0.0

replace example.com/hidden => ../hidden

-- private/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"

	"example.com/hidden"
)

type box struct {
	tag string
}

func (b box) echo[T, U any](v U) U {
	fmt.Println(b.tag, v)
	return v
}

func run() error {
	b := box{tag: "before"}
	errdefer b.echo[int](hidden.New())
	b.tag = "after"
	return errors.New("failure")
}

func main() {
	if err := run(); err == nil {
		panic("missing primary error")
	}
}

-- private/want.txt --
before hidden
-- hidden/go.mod --
module example.com/hidden

go 1.27

-- hidden/hidden.go --
package hidden

type value struct{}

// String identifies the private value.
func (value) String() string { return "hidden" }

// New returns a value whose concrete type cannot be named by callers.
func New() value { return value{} }
